cores.textbox: At the beginning of your end phase, if you've attacked 2 or more times with weapons this turn, you may remove a -1{d} counter from this.{br}**Battleworn**

faces.printed_rules_text:
At the beginning of your end phase, if you have attacked 2 or more times with weapons this turn, you may remove a -1{d} counter from Valiant Dynamo.
**Battleworn** _(If you defend with Valiant Dynamo, put a -1{d} counter on it when the combat chain closes.)_
rules_text_html:

Battleworn (If you defend with Valiant Dynamo, put a -1 counter on it when the combat chain closes.)
